summary: The filing is an 8-K by Real Asset Acquisition Corp. (RAAQ), a SPAC, reporting that the registration statement on Form F-4 for its business combination with IQM Finland Oy has been declared effective by the SEC. The transaction was previously announced on February 22, 2026. The registrant, a blank-check company, is the SPAC vehicle merging with a quantum computing firm. The definitive proxy/prospectus has been mailed to shareholders for the extraordinary general meeting. No specific terms, premiums, or advisors are detailed in this excerpt. Watch for shareholder vote outcome and redemption rate, which will dictate post-deal float and stock performance.
